source.use: Question-number coverage index only. Secondary answers are not the oracle. Independent synthetic prompts live in scenarios.json.

coverage_meaning.covered: Existing prompts and criteria exercise the central concern, not every subquestion and not a passing trial.
coverage_meaning.partial: Related scenario exists but omits material parts.
coverage_meaning.missing: No dedicated baseline scenario identified; general research guidance may still help.
coverage_meaning.outside_scope: Complete specialized outcome exceeds current sole-trader scope; test factual preparation and appropriate routing, not promised completion.

pilot.mode: Opt-in tools/run_research_evals.py with native public web search and visible local arithmetic; separate from the ten-case runner. Follow-ups replay captured context.
pilot.grading: Every case-specific criterion plus source inspection, practical usefulness, fact reuse, and no invented actions. Any material wrong deadline/obligation or fabricated action fails; inaccessible decisive evidence is uncertain, never pass.

sources.applicable_period: 2025 onward; pilot founding year 2026
sources.finding: Actual qualifying founding-year turnover limit EUR 25000, no annualization; crossing and subsequent transactions taxable, earlier exempt transactions remain exempt. Registration estimates are distinct.

sources.applicable_period: Mandatory advised calendar-year returns for 2024/2025; no early demand or individual extension
sources.finding: Ordinary advised 2024 deadline 30 April 2026; 2025 deadline 1 March 2027 after Sunday adjustment. Agriculture/forestry has separate rules.

sources.applicable_period: Current consolidated text inspected for 2026 pilot
sources.finding: Listed and similar professions and actual professional activity matter. Does not determine this mixed software business or make a marketing title binding.

sources.applicable_period: Current consolidated text; October 2026 business service
sources.finding: Business-recipient establishment rule is subject to service-specific exceptions; determine actual supply and establishments.

sources.applicable_period: Current consolidated text; October 2026 incoming service
sources.finding: Qualifying incoming foreign business services can create recipient liability; small-business status does not remove this assessment.

sources.applicable_period: Voluntary GKV members; 2026 pilot
sources.finding: Economic capacity and contributory income, provisional evidence and calendar-year finalization; statutory minima/maxima and exceptions remain applicable.

sources.applicable_period: Current page with 2026 context
sources.finding: Voluntary-member contribution assessment can include rental and capital income in addition to business profit.

sources.applicable_period: Page dated 29 January 2026; insurer explanation, not every insurer notice
sources.finding: Profit rather than turnover, expected income/latest tax assessment and final income evidence; possible refund/additional payment.

sources.applicable_period: Current consolidated text; 2026 pilot, sentence 1 no.9
sources.finding: Cumulative conditions include regularly no qualifying insured employee and durably/essentially one client; other occupational grounds are separate.

sources.applicable_period: Current consolidated text; 2026 pilot, subsections 1a and 2-4
sources.finding: Conditional initial exemption requires an application and insurer decision; not automatic for all founders.

sources.applicable_period: Current consolidated text; 2026 pilot
sources.finding: Instructions and organizational integration indicate employment; client count alone does not decide the overall relationship.

sources.applicable_period: 2026 pilot; some extended procedural provisions sunset 30 June 2027
sources.finding: DRV determination assesses individual circumstances; do not turn a preparation checklist into an observed status decision.

sources.applicable_period: Current official FAQ inspected 27 October 2026; questions 2,3,9,11
sources.finding: Gewerbeanmeldung is neither prerequisite nor exclusion. Actual ongoing artistic/publicistic earning activity and individual evidence/assessment matter.

sources.applicable_period: Current consolidated text; 2026 pilot
sources.finding: Activity and employee conditions apply, including exceptions. Other eligibility/exclusion provisions require case-specific checking.

sources.applicable_period: 2026 family-cover case; subsections 1 and 6
sources.finding: Main-occupation exclusion and regular total-income test are separate. Facts and changes must be reported; insurer decision and cover continuity remain separate outcomes.

sources.applicable_period: 2026 total-income definition
sources.finding: Total income sums tax-law income categories; stated net rental income is not omitted from the family-cover assessment.

sources.applicable_period: 2026; official insurer page dated 2025-12-05
sources.finding: Ordinary monthly limit EUR 565; EUR 603 for qualifying marginal employment. With no employment, EUR 450 profit plus EUR 150 net rental income exceeds the ordinary limit.

sources.applicable_period: 2026 compulsory self-employed case; subsection 1
sources.finding: Standard or evidenced income basis; half standard through third calendar year following start year (end 2029 for first start in 2026). Startup records when no assessment exists; annual rates and limits remain applicable.

sources.applicable_period: 2026 row, Pflichtversicherte Selbstständige ab 2025; published 2025-11-10
sources.finding: Published monthly standard EUR 735.63 and half standard EUR 367.82. These are table values, not a personalized income-based assessment or a fixed amount for future years.

sources.applicable_period: Child born September 2026; subsections 1,6,8
sources.finding: Self-employment is not itself excluded; 32 weekly hours averaged over child life-month, with other eligibility and income-ceiling conditions separate.

sources.applicable_period: September 2026 birth; subsection 2; no shifting grounds
sources.finding: Normally last completed pre-birth tax assessment period for self-employment: calendar 2025 on fixture facts. Special grounds and mixed-income rules are separate.

sources.applicable_period: 2026 EÜR case; Arbeit und Einkommen mit Elterngeld
sources.finding: For EÜR, receipt timing matters even for earlier work; gross receipts are not one-to-one award reductions. Forecast/provisional then actual/final evidence; balance-sheet timing differs.

sources.applicable_period: 2026 domestic German-parent/minor-child case; page dated 2026-01-01
sources.finding: Kindergeld is income-independent and generally covers children under 18; business start or higher parental profit alone does not remove entitlement on the stated facts.

sources.applicable_period: 2026 existing Kindergeld claim, minor child
sources.finding: Relevant household, residence, payment and foreign-benefit changes go promptly to Familienkasse. Reporting to another authority is not sufficient; no universal profit-fluctuation reporting duty is inferred.

sources.applicable_period: 2026 base/follow-up; subsection 2
sources.finding: Erwerbstätigkeit includes employment and self-employment. Unrestricted wording changes the conclusion from employment-only evidence.

sources.applicable_period: 2026 valid-title case; subsections 1 and 3
sources.finding: Statutory/title conditions and full restrictions matter; copied Beschäftigung wording alone does not establish freelance permission. Do not infer authorization from tax registration.

sources.applicable_period: 2026; subsections 5 and 6
sources.finding: Freelance and possible side self-employment permission routes; professional permission remains separate. Not every valid-title holder needs a new section 21 title.

sources.applicable_period: 2026 ordinary ALG I case; subsections 1 and 2
sources.finding: At least 150 remaining entitlement days at commencement plus viability and capabilities; 120 fails ordinary condition. Main work or business plan does not cure it.

sources.applicable_period: 2026; fixture expressly excludes disability/rehabilitation exception
sources.finding: Discretionary grant, at least 15 weekly hours for main activity, preparations before starting. Disability exception exists but is not applicable to this fixture; alternative support needs separate eligibility.

sources.applicable_period: 2026 ordinary ALG I continuation; subsection 3
sources.finding: Ordinary unemployment requires work under 15 weekly hours, subject to narrow exceptions; planned 20-hour self-employment is not harmless to continued ordinary ALG I.

sources.applicable_period: 2026 ordinary domestic invoice; excludes sections 3c,6a,13b UStG
sources.finding: EUR 250 inclusive gross total; supplier identity/address, issue date, goods/service particulars, combined gross amount and rate suffice for reduced minimum fields. EUR 250.01 loses relief.

sources.applicable_period: 2026; subsections 1,2,4
sources.finding: Structured e-invoice definition and ordinary fields: party identities, supplier tax number or VAT ID, issue date, unique number, supply description/date, net consideration and applicable reductions, rate and tax amount. Conditional special fields are not universal.

sources.applicable_period: 2025-2026 supplies sent by 31 December 2026; subsection 38
sources.finding: Paper or consented other electronic format remains permitted in first transition; no preceding-year turnover condition for this 2026 case.

sources.applicable_period: 2026; questions 2,11,12
sources.finding: Unstructured PDF is a sonstige Rechnung, not E-Rechnung. Issuing transition does not defer receiving structured invoices since 2025; receiving can use an email inbox.

sources.applicable_period: 2026; subsection 5 sentence 1 nos.6b/6c
sources.finding: Separate Arbeitszimmer and daily allowance regimes; EUR 6 per qualifying day, EUR 1260 maximum across activities. Double-household deductible accommodation and overlapping room deductions excluded.

sources.applicable_period: 2026 official handbook
sources.finding: Confirms applicable daily allowance law: 180 eligible days yield EUR 1080 below annual cap; deduction is not the same as tax saved.

sources.applicable_period: Circular 15 August 2023 for post-2022 work, reproduced in 2024 handbook; read with 2026 law
sources.finding: Paragraphs 3-4 distinguish shared living room from qualifying Arbeitszimmer; 27-30 daily conditions and day records. A practical day log is not a mandatory official form. Retrieved directly via HTTP after web-reader failure.

sources.applicable_period: Q3 2026; subsection 1; quarterly status stipulated
sources.finding: Advance return and payment ordinarily due by tenth day after the period. Annual/adviser-return deadlines are distinct.

sources.applicable_period: Q3 2026 dates; subsection 3
sources.finding: Saturday/Sunday/holiday deadline moves to next working day; 10 October 2026 Saturday becomes Monday 12 October on Berlin facts.

sources.applicable_period: Effective existing Dauerfristverlängerung for Q3 2026
sources.finding: One-month extension for return and payment gives 10 November 2026, not 12 November by adding a month to adjusted October date. Direct HTTP retrieval verified after web-reader failure.

sources.applicable_period: 2026 quarterly filer with valid existing extension
sources.finding: Application timing and monthly special advance-payment procedure; do not require a new application or invent monthly special prepayment for the stipulated quarterly case.

sources.applicable_period: Berlin 2026 calendar
sources.finding: Neither 12 October nor 10 November is a public holiday. Weekdays independently computed; third-party/unadjusted dates or a redirected 2027 calendar do not override the 2026 statutory rule.

sources.applicable_period: 2026 acquisition; subsections 2 and 2a
sources.finding: Optional immediate deduction for qualifying independently usable movable depreciable assets up to EUR 800 relevant cost. Record above EUR 250 unless particulars apparent in accounts. EUR 800.01 loses GWG relief; no-pool fixture retained.

sources.applicable_period: 2026 acquisition; ordinary AfA and applicable 2025-2027 movable-asset alternatives
sources.finding: Crossing GWG ceiling does not automatically select one depreciation method or useful life. Determine applicable treatment from source and asset facts without an invented charge.

sources.applicable_period: BMF letter 22 February 2022, paragraphs 1-3 and 6-8, official EStH 2025 reproduction; applies fiscal years ending after 2020; bounded 2026 check found no superseding restriction
sources.finding: Qualifying notebook may use one-year useful life and full acquisition-year AfA despite October acquisition and cost above GWG ceiling. Not GWG, new depreciation method or formal section 5(1) election. Asset records retained; net cost separate from deductible VAT.

sources.applicable_period: 2026 ongoing services; subsection 1; other deduction conditions stipulated
sources.finding: Input VAT relates to enterprise use with valid invoice; do not infer full entitlement for private use of ongoing services.

sources.applicable_period: UStAE 15.2c(2) no. 1, official 2024 handbook; corroborated by current official UStAE PDF during 2026 check
sources.finding: Mixed services must be apportioned; telephone service expressly acquired for enterprise only to business-use extent. Distinct from capital-good allocation choices.

sources.applicable_period: Current official PDF search extraction inspected 2026-10-27, section 15.2c
sources.finding: Corroborates mixed telephone-service apportionment; not proof of a personalized VAT assessment or a full archived PDF payload.

sources.applicable_period: Official 2025 help used for accounting distinction, NOT 2026 form-line mapping
sources.finding: Net mixed telecommunications expense and paid deductible input VAT are separate EÜR expense items. Fixture business net EUR 840 plus paid input VAT EUR 159.60 gives EUR 999.60 expense-side cash; private gross EUR 428.40. Separate refunds/settlements remain distinct.

sources.applicable_period: BMF vehicle guidance, official EStH 2025 reproduction, paragraph 31, checked for 2026 fixture
sources.finding: 10-50% business use excludes the 1% method; actual-cost private withdrawal. At 40/60 and established EUR 10000 cost, private EUR 6000 leaves net business EUR 4000. This does not determine VAT or certify a Fahrtenbuch.

sources.applicable_period: October 2026 ordinary human consultancy; subsections 1, 2, 4 and 5
sources.finding: B2B recipient-place France; corrected French private consumer uses German supplier-place rule. Live calls/bespoke emails alone do not make an automated electronic service or trigger digital EUR 10000/OSS rules.

sources.applicable_period: Consolidated VAT Directive, 14 April 2025, Articles 44, 45, 192a and 196; applicable 2026 fixture
sources.finding: Customer-place B2B and recipient liability where supplier not established in customer state. Current article 196 inspected via official search extraction; direct page hit JavaScript verification.

sources.applicable_period: 2026 bounded French business purchase of ordinary service from German-established supplier
sources.finding: French official guidance confirms French VAT/customer liability for the supplied B2B facts. No German VAT is charged; not a German-exempt domestic transaction.

sources.applicable_period: October 2026 intra-EU recipient-liability service; subsection 1
sources.finding: Both VAT IDs and recipient-liability wording accompany ordinary particulars; statutory following-month fifteenth-day invoice rule. No invented IDs or issued invoice.

sources.applicable_period: 2026 EU B2B service; subsections 2, 7 and 8
sources.finding: General ZM inclusion for specified recipient-liability EU services; actual cadence/exemptions require taxpayer facts. Corrected EU-consumer ordinary service is not a ZM sale.

sources.applicable_period: 2026 VAT returns/advance returns for EU services
sources.finding: Separate reporting for relevant intra-EU services in performance period; no guessed form line, filing cadence, submission or receipt.

sources.applicable_period: 2026 income-tax vehicle private use; subsection 1 no. 4
sources.finding: 1% method requires more than 50% business use. A properly assigned business car at 40% business use remains outside that method; supplied actual costs support a separate private-use adjustment.

sources.applicable_period: October 2026 services; subsections 1, 2, 3 no.1, 4 no.3 and 5
sources.finding: Full current statutory text inspected. US business advice follows recipient establishment; technical advice to US consumer follows the third-country exception. Corrected EU consumer advice follows Germany. Specific-site property plans follow France; automated software follows electronic-service rules.

sources.applicable_period: October 2026 service ZM; subsections 2 and 7 no.3
sources.finding: Full public statutory HTML inspected by direct HTTP after web timeouts. Service ZM concerns qualifying section 3a(2) services in another EU state with recipient liability; no such ZM for these US, consumer or property-location transactions. This does not exclude other return disclosures.

sources.applicable_period: Official PDF header 2 June 2026, inspected 27 October 2026; sections 3a.2(11)/(12), 3a.3(8)/(10), 3a.9a and 3a.12
sources.finding: Direct public HTTP retrieved full 7928607-byte PDF after web 503; parsed relevant text, SHA256 ab78ca30d2e9573755053f3b2d2a96f0987b26953176c1ade54a44f5c152aa5f. Supports alternative US business evidence, specific-site property distinction, automatic software classification and destination treatment from the entire threshold-crossing sale, without retroactive change to earlier sales.

sources.applicable_period: Regulation 282/2011 Articles 7 and 18(3); checked alongside current 2026 BMF guidance
sources.finding: Official indexed original text supports automated software classification and alternative third-country business evidence. Direct current-consolidation retrieval blocked by JavaScript/bot challenge; no full consolidated-page inspection claimed. Current full German statute and BMF guidance independently corroborate decisive propositions.

sources.applicable_period: Regulation 1042/2013 introduction of Article 31a(2)(a)/(3)(a); checked against current BMF property guidance
sources.finding: Official indexed text distinguishes plans for a particular plot from generic plans. Direct EUR-Lex retrieval blocked; current full BMF section 3a.3 corroborates the bounded identified-site fixture. No French liability/registration conclusion established.

sources.applicable_period: Official Commission OSS guidance inspected 27 October 2026, including section 9
sources.finding: Full page inspected. Combined VAT-exclusive EUR 10000 test uses prior/current years and single-state conditions. The EUR 9800 plus EUR 500 crossing sale follows France for all EUR 500; earlier EUR 9800 is not retroactively changed. OSS is optional and does not replace domestic returns.

sources.applicable_period: October 2026 Union OSS procedure
sources.finding: Full statutory text inspected. Notification, scope and valid participation must be checked; threshold crossing does not enroll a trader. Ordinary destination-country compliance remains the alternative. No registration or submission is performed.

sources.applicable_period: 2026 cross-border small-enterprise exemption procedure
sources.finding: Full statutory text inspected. Foreign exemption has its own application and eligibility conditions, distinct from the EUR 10000 place rule and OSS. Fixture expressly excludes exemption; ordinary German VAT liability alone would not establish that exclusion.

sources.applicable_period: September 2026, existing monthly UStVA duty; subsections 1 and 2
sources.finding: Full statutory text inspected. No sales does not itself remove the stipulated monthly duty; no exemption was granted. The fixture does not ask for filing-date or penalty calculations.

sources.applicable_period: 2026 complete UStG, section 15(1) no.1; act header amendment 29 June 2026
sources.finding: Full-act HTML recovered the relevant section after single-page timeout. Confirmed business invoice gives EUR 19 input tax against EUR 0 output tax; wholly private correction removes it. Supplied deduction period and other conditions are not rederived.

sources.applicable_period: 2026 AO section 168; act header amendment 3 July 2026
sources.finding: Full-act HTML recovered section 168 after single-page timeout. A calculated input-tax excess is not proof of authority consent, offset or paid refund; no specific repayment date or actual submission follows from arithmetic.

sources.applicable_period: 2025 return expressly requested in 2026; subsection 1
sources.finding: Full statutory text inspected. A valid tax-office request creates the specified filing duty despite no receipts. The supplied valid extension to 30 November 2026 is retained; no generic deadline substitutes for it.

sources.applicable_period: 2025 EÜR requested in 2026; subsection 4
sources.finding: Full statutory text inspected. EÜR uses the prescribed dataset with the statutory hardship alternative. This supports preparation, not a claim of an actual submitted form.

sources.applicable_period: 2025 business result; subsections 3 and 4, checked with ELSTER 2025 guidance
sources.finding: Full statutory text inspected. Stipulated EUR 0 receipts minus EUR 1200 qualifying paid gross costs yields EUR -1200 business loss; this is not personal income-tax liability or recognized loss acceptance.

sources.applicable_period: 2026 ESt prepayments; subsections 1, 3 and 5
sources.finding: Full statutory text inspected. Finanzamt sets and may adjust prepayments. EUR 2000 supported annual tax after withholding minus EUR 1800 credited prepayments leaves EUR 200 forecast remainder; the effective December notice remains EUR 600 until changed or other relief applies.

sources.applicable_period: 2026 existing prepayment notice; subsection 2
sources.finding: Full statutory text inspected. A valid administrative act continues until changed or otherwise resolved; a request alone does not authorize unilateral underpayment.

sources.applicable_period: Public ELSTER adjustment form checked 27 October 2026
sources.finding: Public title/version page inspected. Establishes a named adjustment-request route, not account access, field-level acceptance or a submitted/approved request. The draft uses placeholders only.

sources.applicable_period: 2026 personal income-tax prepayments; no.3
sources.finding: Full statutory text inspected. Personal income-tax payments are not deductible operating expenses in EÜR; cash outflow is separate from business profit.

pilot.limits: Primary-source verification covers only bounded pilot expectations. Baseline coverage labels remain historical. Batch 2 does not cover every insurance or benefit variant, Einstiegsgeld, residence title, actual authority decision or complete application. Other rows still require dated source research before a legal answer rubric. Repository status/validation owns observed outcomes. Batch 3 tests specified domestic invoice particulars/transition, a bounded homeworking allowance and confirmed quarterly VAT deadlines; not complete invoice validation, asset accounting, all expense categories or every filing frequency. Batch 4 covers specified movable assets, supported mixed-service/car allocations and ordinary German-French human consultancy. It does not certify all asset choices, VAT allocations, foreign income taxes, permanent establishments, third-country supplies or actual ledger/filing integrations.
